svg.title: Every pin of the tile, at its real position
svg.text: Every pin, where it really is
The 1x2 tile at true scale (161.00 × 225.76 µm), with its 43 pins on metal 4 along the top edge, exactly where Tiny Tapeout's own template (tt_block_1x2_pg.def) puts them.
The band spreads them out so each one can be named with its function.
the design's real sky130 cells, placed by block (routing is added by the hardening flow)
